audit.whatIsWrong: Every row of the full-layer chart read 'Skill' while the content layer read Veigar 1-5 and Aurelion Sol 6-7.
audit.why: All seven rows rendered two different answers. The packet chart matches the content layer, and the owner wins 52.11% over 735 games, so the late rows belong to Aurelion Sol rather than being neutral.
audit.corrected: phases[0..4].side = Veigar, phases[5].side and phases[6].side = Aurelion Sol.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer names 'Starsurge', 'Comet of Legend', 'Voice of Light', 'stacked stars' and 'dash options'.
audit.why: None of those exist in Aurelion Sol's kit. It is Stardust (P), Breath of Light (Q, 3s), Astral Flight (W, 22/20.5/19/17.5/16), the black hole (E, 12s) and Falling Star / The Skies Descend (R, 120/110/100). Veigar's spikes are Baleful Strike stacks from minute one, Event Horizon at 3 (20/18.5/17/15.5/14) and Primordial Burst at 6 (120/90/60, 650 range).
audit.corrected: Rewrote the spike text around stardust banking, Astral Flight and The Skies Descend.

audit.whatIsWrong: Event Horizon cancelling Aurelion Sol's channels is never stated, and the cage-edge rule is never tied to Astral Flight.
audit.why: Breath of Light (Q) and Astral Flight (W) are both interruptible channels, and Event Horizon is Veigar's only hard CC — its stun ends the beam and drops him out of flight. Because only the edge stuns, the correct answer to being caged is to move toward the centre and wait it out, not to fly out through the wall. Primordial Burst carries no CC, so it cannot cancel a channel on its own; it just needs you low, and your black hole's own execute means low-HP trading favours neither of you.
audit.corrected: Channel only after the cage is spent; never route Astral Flight through the cage edge.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns is a template with no numbers.
audit.why: Event Horizon is 20s at rank 1 falling to 14s, Baleful Strike 6s to 4s, Primordial Burst 120/90/60, Astral Flight 22s at rank 1. Dark Matter's cooldown shrinks with his passive stacks, so it never becomes a window.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around the cage as the one punishable cooldown.

audit.why: Denying Baleful Strike stacks is genuinely his scaling lever — Riot's text confirms units killed by the bolt grant permanent AP — and wants.you[2] already says to zone him off it.

edits.after: Once you finish your first item your beam outpokes Baleful Strike, and Astral Flight repositions you out of Event Horizon setups — but never fly out through the cage edge, since only the edge stuns.

edits.before: With Comet of Legend and stacked stars you can roam and one-shot squishies from range that his flat AP stacking can't match, while his cage combo becomes a one-and-done cooldown you can play around.
edits.after: With deep stardust banked, The Skies Descend drags whole teams off the line he wants to cage, and his combo becomes a single 14s cooldown you step around rather than the thing that decides the fight.

edits.before: Veigar's Baleful Strike farm poke and Dark Matter zoning outpace your unstacked Starsurge in the early trades, and any misplaced Event Horizon cage into a full combo can delete you before your kit online, so you're playing cautious and ceding lane tempo through level 5.
edits.after: Veigar's Baleful Strike farm poke and Dark Matter zoning outpace your unstacked beam in the early trades, and an Event Horizon into the full combo deletes you before your kit is online. Remember only the cage EDGE stuns — walk toward the centre and wait, never back out through the wall.

edits.before: His Event Horizon setup plus Primordial Burst execute remains a real all-in threat right up to level 6, since his damage scales off stacks he's already banked while your Comet of Legend and Voice of Light stars are still catching up — you need to respect his cage range every wave.
edits.after: His Event Horizon setup into Primordial Burst stays a real all-in threat past level 6, since his AP scales off stacks he has already banked while your stardust is still catching up. The cage is 20s at rank 1 and it cancels both Breath of Light and Astral Flight, so start a beam only once it is spent.

edits.before: Once your first item lands your range, kite tools, and stacked Q burst start winning the poke war outright, and by two items your Comet of Legend roams and stacked Starsurge one-shot potential outscale his stat-check AP stacking, turning his all-in from a threat into a single dodgeable cooldown.
edits.after: Once your first item lands, your range and stardust-fed beam start winning the poke war outright, and by two items Astral Flight roams and The Skies Descend outscale his stat-check AP stacking, turning his all-in from a threat into one 14s cooldown you walk around. Never route the flight through his cage edge.

edits.before: - Veigar Event Horizon (Cage): matchup-defining — Only the cage EDGE stuns — hold position near the center or leave before it forms; never dash into the wall. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Astral Flight like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Event Horizon is 20s at rank 1 and it is his only hard CC — with it spent you can channel for twenty seconds. Only the edge stuns, so move to the centre. - Dark Matter's cooldown shrinks with his stacks; it is never a window. - Astral Flight is 22s and it dies to the cage edge.

edits.before: Only the cage EDGE stuns — hold position near the center or leave before it forms; never dash into the wall. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Only the cage EDGE stuns — if it lands on you, stand still in the middle and keep channelling. Commit on its 20s downtime, never into it.

edits.before: W-flyby: fly a lateral arc, drag Q across Veigar for two seconds of burn + stacks, and land outside his answer range — repeat forever from one item.
edits.after: Black-hole his caster minions before he does — every one Baleful Strike kills is permanent AP for him, and every one your execute kills is stardust for you.

edits.before: Your flight is your only escape — a W spent poking is a death sentence against the next gank.
edits.after: Flying out through the cage wall stuns you mid-air — that is the one exit Event Horizon actually seals.

edits.before: If Veigar takes first blood, tighten up: Event Horizon (Cage) is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with E executes and stay relevant through the stardust curve.
edits.after: If Veigar takes first blood he keeps the AP forever, so stop feeding the passive: never die to the cage twice for the same misstep. A second kill ends the duel, not the game — clear with the black hole and keep banking stardust.

notes: Content layer described the pre-rework Aurelion Sol — 'Starsurge', 'Comet of Legend', 'Voice of Light', 'stacked stars', 'dash options'. All rewritten to Breath of Light / Astral Flight / black hole / Falling Star. Full-layer level chart had all seven rows on 'Skill' against the content layer and the packet chart; all seven flipped as one group, which also answers the packet defect 'level chart contradicts data'. Whether Event Horizon's stun is shortened by tenacity or removed by Cleanse/QSS is not in Riot's text and was not asserted.
